qualification: Every current JSON value preserved, including all row values. Common fields apply to every row; varying row arrays follow declared columns. Exact decode equals each original. Actual complete view reading remains required; generation grants no source/semantic approval.

value.mapping_method: Manual semantic units and explicit atomic assertions; code/line enumeration is locator machinery only, not a completeness denominator.

premises: Fixed R, valid supplied objects, normal completion unless the atom states a failure boundary.
